S2_classification: S2 distinguishes + / - iff q=3 or q>=5; equivalently iff q not in {2,4}.
S3_classification: Same q-domain as S2; the added -1/-2 probes do not create a new distinguishable q-class.
S4_classification: Same branch-sign q-domain as S2/S3. Exact magnitudes can identify q=2's doubled source multiplicity, but cannot distinguish the two branch classes at q=2 or q=4.

count_signature_symmetry_obstruction.D0_obstruction: If qN>2, H^2 is nonidentity on the tag's H orbit, so paired histories cannot collapse to one tagged target without branch/tag provenance or symmetry-breaking input.
count_signature_symmetry_obstruction.field_invariance: C(tau x)=C(x) iff the residue support {+1,-1} is invariant under +2; for q>=2 this occurs exactly at q=2 or q=4.
count_signature_symmetry_obstruction.incompatible_required_actions: to reach V X_i in one H action, z_i^- requires H while z_i^+ requires H_INV.
count_signature_symmetry_obstruction.inductive_extension: Any q/N-independent equivariant controller reading only current relational ingress plus current count-field signatures assigns identical action sets to tau-related histories. Since declared channel actions commute with tau, paired continuations remain H^2-related at every later round.
count_signature_symmetry_obstruction.ingress_preserved: both post-V branches have current ingress class V; H^2 relabeling preserves declared channel labels.
count_signature_symmetry_obstruction.q2_N1_degeneracy: At q=2,N=1, H^2=id; the obstruction degenerates, but launch configuration support is singleton and fails Stage-D nontrivial branching evidence.

exact_count_field.formula: C(H^m V X_0)=kappa*(1[m=+1 mod q]+1[m=-1 mod q])
exact_count_field.kappa_all_orders: 2^(N-1)*(N!)^2 per branch source at the post-V boundary
exact_count_field.kappa_sync: 2^(N-1) per branch source at the post-V boundary
exact_count_field.probe_formula: C(H^r z_i^s)=kappa*(1[s+r=+1 mod q]+1[s+r=-1 mod q]), s in {+1,-1}
exact_count_field.support_bit_formula: B_(r)(z_i^s)=1 iff s+r is congruent to +1 or -1 modulo q
